subject: Persistent telemetry pack — cost-share pilot & pricing scenarios
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@cloudmed.ai>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudmed.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Telemetry add-ons — retention, tracing, dashboards (intro)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We're interested in Redwood's observability add-ons but need to understand the cost tradeoffs for: longer retention (90/180/365 days), distributed tracing ingest and sampling, and the advanced dashboards pack (real-time dashboards + historical aggregations).

Can you share a couple of practical pricing scenarios for:
- a small pilot (3 services, ~200k traces/month)
- an expansion (20 services, 2M traces/month)

Also: what kind of commitment discounts (if any) do you offer for a 6–12 month pilot that might expand to full rollout? Procurement (procurement@cloudmed.ai) will also need invoicing cadence and an example SOW.

Ideal if you can send a short costing spreadsheet + a one-page outline we can circulate internally.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Product Ops
CloudMed

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@cloudmed.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — retention, tracing, dashboards (intro)

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask. Attached are: a one‑pager that outlines the "Persistent Telemetry Pack" (features + retention tiers) and an editable pricing model (pricing_model_v1.xlsx) with example scenarios. High level notes below so your team can circulate quickly.

Summary (pilot vs expansion):
- Pilot (3 services / ~200k traces/month): recommended retention 90 days; sampling budget ~10% to control cost; estimated monthly add-on cost: $6,500 with a small ingest credit for the first month.
- Expansion (20 services / ~2M traces/month): recommended retention 180 days; adaptive sampling + archive tier for cold traces; estimated monthly add-on cost: $48k.

Discount & commitment framing suggestions:
- 3 month pilot: standard list pricing + 10% onboarding credit (one-time).
- 6–12 month pilot with commit to Dedicated/Reserved capacity: up to 20% off add-on list (tiered by total committed dollars) and one month of retention included free (applies to first invoice).

Pilot suggestion: a cost-share pilot where CloudMed covers 70% of expected monthly add-on costs and Redwood covers 30% as a product validation credit for the first 90 days. This helps de-risk the trial and accelerates data collection for us to tune sampling/quant profiles.

I've put Ben on cc — he can speak to discounts and the finance path. Karthik can help with the technical SOW and what controls we'll need for tracing sampling.

Attachments: persistent_telemetry_outline.pdf, pricing_model_v1.xlsx

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
aomi_feldman@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@cloudmed.ai>, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — retention, tracing, dashboards (intro)

Maya — quick follow up from finance/discount side.

We like the cost-share pilot approach Naomi suggested. Practical counter-proposal for procurement:
- Pilot term: 3 months. CloudMed pays 70% of the modeled monthly add-on cost (as-priced in the attached spreadsheet); Redwood applies a 30% product validation credit (applied as a line-item credit on invoices).
- If CloudMed converts to a 12-month committed add-on + dedicated inference capacity within 90 days of pilot start, we can apply an additional 10% conversion credit to the first 6 months of committed invoices (effective total concessions up to ~40% in year 1 depending on capacity commitment).
- Invoicing cadence: monthly invoices with Net 30 standard terms; procurement can request quarterly invoicing if needed (we'll accommodate for enterprise contracts).

I've attached a short PDF with the pilot cost-share math and an example invoice treatment. If procurement wants a netting arrangement or PO-based milestone billing, we can surface that in the SOW.

Let's try to get procurement and legal in a quick 30‑minute sync this week to lock the SOW and invoicing terms.

Attachment: pilot_cost_share_proposal_v2.pdf

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Maya Singh <maya@cloudmed.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudmed.ai, Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudmed.ai>
Date: 2027-06-04T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Telemetry add-ons — retention, tracing, dashboards (intro)

Thanks Naomi and Ben — the proposal looks reasonable and the cost-share idea is appealing to leadership. A few asks before procurement can sign:

1) Can you provide a short SLA addendum for the pilot that covers data availability (dashboarding) and retention guarantees for the 90‑day pilot? We don't need full enterprise SLAs for the pilot, but we do require availability > 99.5% for dashboard refresh windows and clear retention handling.
2) Please confirm the exact deliverables we should expect from Redwood during the 90 days (dashboard templates, sampling knobs, a handover checklist).
3) Procurement prefers a single DocuSign SOW + PO flow — can you send the DocuSign link and a sample SOW by end of day Friday?

If you can provide the items above we'll route to procurement and legal. We'll also be ready to share a PO form if needed. Scheduling: happy to do a 30m call tomorrow morning to align.

Best,
Maya
Head of Product Ops
CloudMed
